prompt.fork: Find a move that attacks two pieces at once.
prompt.pin: Find a move that wins by using a pin.
prompt.skewer: Attack the big piece in front and win the piece behind it.
prompt.discoveredAttack: Move one piece out of the way to unleash a hidden attack.
prompt.doubleAttack: Find a move that makes two threats at once.
prompt.defense: Stop your opponent's threat and keep your pieces safe.
prompt.endgame: Find the precise winning move in this endgame.
prompt.tactic: Find the best move to win material.

solve.revealed: Here is the solution. Try it again yourself.
solve.stars3: Solved first try with no hints!

hint1.mate: The enemy king has very few escape squares.
hint1.fork: Two enemy pieces can be hit by one of your pieces.
hint1.pin: An enemy piece can't move freely because of a more important piece behind it.
hint1.skewer: A big piece and another piece stand on the same line.
hint1.discoveredAttack: One of your pieces is blocking another piece's line of attack.
hint1.doubleAttack: One move can create two threats.
hint1.defense: First ask what your opponent is threatening.
hint1.endgame: With few pieces left, every king and pawn step matters.
hint1.tactic: Look for an enemy piece that is unprotected or weak.
hint1.check: The first move is a check.
hint1.capture: The first move captures a piece.
hint1.quiet: The first move is a quiet move (no check, no capture).

explainT.fork: {move}: the {piece} on {square} attacks {targets} at once — a fork.
explainT.pin: {move}: the pinned {pinned} cannot move freely, and that wins material.
explainT.skewer: {move}: the {front} must move away, and the {back} behind it is won — a skewer.
explainT.discoveredAttack: {move}: a piece steps aside and opens the {attacker}'s line — a discovered attack.
explainT.doubleAttack: {move}: one move threatens {targets} at the same time.
explainT.defense: {move}: it stops the threat and saves material. Most other moves lose a piece.
explainT.endgame: {line}: the only way to win (or hold) this endgame.
